description: Run agentgate's own checks over a local directory: MCP client configuration, hooks, manifests and source patterns a policy would refuse. Use it on a project you can read; it is not a record lookup, so for one server's record use lookup_server and for a list of tools use inventory_tools. It only reads files; it does not install, execute or upload anything, and it does not scan the network.

exclude.description: Comma-separated directories to skip. Defaults to node_modules,.git

policy.description: Path to an agentgate.policy.json. Defaults to the one in root, or the built-in default.

root.description: Directory to check. Defaults to the working directory.

name: check_project

coverage.description: what the policy could not measure: a check that failed, and evidence the index did not have

indexWarning.description: Present only when the server was started with a note about the index it loaded.

verdict.description: clean, findings or incomplete; incomplete is not a pass

title: Scan a local project for refused configuration
